amendments.body: Avoid running the same habitat probes twice under identical seeds/artifact labels. `all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary` re-invokes every probe in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:1342-1405`, even though those same probes are still standalone `#[test]`s at `:249`, `:521`, `:712`, `:900`, and `:1185`. `HarnessRun::artifact_dir` is derived only from `scenario_id`, `artifact_label`, and seed in `crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:624-640`, so under Rust's default parallel test execution the summary test and the corresponding individual test can race on the same temp directory and clobber failure artifacts.
amendments.rationale: This is a robustness bug: the new summary test makes the failure-diagnostics path nondeterministic precisely when a probe fails.

amendments.body: Tighten the light-depth probe so it actually requires plant growth, not just 'less negative growth'. The only semantic check is `growth_shallow > growth_deep` in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:627-657`. On the current test run that passes with both values negative (`shallow=-0.4029 g`, `deep=-0.7110 g`), so the probe reports success even though neither tank experienced the documented 'more plant biomass growth after 14 days'.
amendments.rationale: As written, this probe can miss a real regression where both scenarios are shrinking instead of growing.

amendments.body: Remove the built-in nitrifier advantage from the biofilter-scaling setup. In `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:310-317`, each run seeds nitrifier biomass as `carrying_capacity * INITIAL_CAPACITY_FRACTION`, and `carrying_capacity` itself depends on filter-media area. Because the larger-media run is constructed with the same seed path at `:322-335`, it starts with more nitrifier biomass before any simulation dynamics occur, then the assertions at `:435-457` check for lower reduced-N exposure and higher final nitrifier biomass. That makes the probe partially tautological and weakens its ability to catch regressions in the actual biofilter growth/capacity behavior.
amendments.rationale: This is a correctness gap in the test design: the setup pre-bakes the expected advantage instead of isolating it as the behavior under test.

payload.summary: Found three substantive issues in the new habitat-probe changes: the added summary test can race with the individual probe tests on shared artifact paths, the light-depth probe currently passes even when both tanks are losing plant biomass, and the biofilter-scaling probe seeds the larger filter with a built-in nitrifier advantage that weakens the regression signal.
